allow: PowerShell($c = Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\\.claude.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; "== root mcpServers =="; $c.mcpServers.PSObject.Properties.Name; "== per-project mcp =="; $c.projects.PSObject.Properties | ForEach-Object { $n=$_.Name; $s=$_.Value.mcpServers; if \($s\) { "$n -> " + \($s.PSObject.Properties.Name -join ', '\) } })

PowerShell($c = Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\\.claude.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; "== top-level keys =="; $c.PSObject.Properties.Name | Where-Object { $_ -match 'mcp|oauth|connector|account|organization|scope|team' }; "== oauthAccount =="; $c.oauthAccount | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3)
